This omission creates a memory leak vulnerability, which can lead to resource exhaustion and denial-of-service, impacting system stability and availability.

This vulnerability could be exploited to overwrite adjacent memory, potentially causing crashes or enabling arbitrary code execution, thus compromising system integrity and security.
